ranking.note: Foundation (BlockTemplateManager) that #33922 builds on plus real latency/lock-contention win; placed first among P2s.
Depends on the BlockTemplateManager introduced in #35581, so reviewed after it.
Demoted: reviewers state the no-mempool case is largely theoretical, making it as marginal as the other edge-case fix #36156.

inconsistencies: #35581 introduces the BlockTemplateManager that #33922 extends with reference counting; review #35581 first or #33922 will be re-worked.
#35598 was extracted from #33922 as a standalone test of pre-existing waitNext behaviour; it can be reviewed independently and merging it first reduces #33922's surface.

#35300 (deprecates capnp ordinals for submitBlock/submitSolution) and #36097 (deprecates the interrupt methods on the same Mining capnp interface) both reshape the same interface definition; coordinate ordinal/deprecation changes to avoid conflicting client-compatibility rules. #35300 is the more consequential of the two and should be reviewed first.

#36097 carries a temporary subtree commit pending upstream libmultiprocess#342; the Core-side code is reviewable now but merge order depends on that upstream bump (an ipc-category dependency, not a priority factor).
#36192 and #35598 are both Sjors test-coverage additions to interface_ipc_mining.py and touch shared regtest constants; they may conflict textually.
result.notes: The category splits cleanly: four PRs extending or optimising the Mining IPC interface that Stratum v2 consumers depend on (P2), a middle group of user-visible bug fixes, tooling and test coverage (P3), and three narrow edge-case/log changes (P4). No PR here touches block template validity in a way that could lose a block reward, so nothing reaches P1; #36156 is the only one that risks invalidity and its upside is under 1000 sats, which is why it sits last.
